plan: A rock tank who charges into the middle of your team with his ultimate to start the fight.
aSurveiller: His R (Unstoppable Force). He charges from afar and knocks up everyone grouped together: don't stand right next to each other.
contrer: Stay spread out in team fights so his R only hits one person.
Magic damage hurts him much more than physical: he mostly stacks armour.
Get ahead before level 6: without his R he isn't very dangerous.
forces: His R can start a fight on several enemies at once.
His passive shield helps him hold his lane.
faiblesses: Low damage when he plays tank.
Almost harmless if he misses his R.

sorts.P: Shield that recharges if he isn't hit for a few seconds.
sorts.Q: Throws a shard that damages and steals movement speed.
sorts.W: His attacks create shockwaves in front of him.
sorts.E: Slams the ground: damage based on armour and reduced attack speed.
sorts.R: Charges at high speed and knocks everyone up.

momentFort.voie: Not very dangerous before level 6. After that, his R can decide every team fight.
momentFort.jungle: Barely ganks before level 6. He farms to get his R, which then makes his ganks very dangerous.
